title: Plan 22: coordinate victual-kit HealthKit integration and native acceptance
body:
Plan: [Plan 22](https://github.com/datagen24/victual/blob/master/docs/plans/22-medication-tracking.md). Scope decisions: PR #692. Target: milestone 0.5.0.

This is the Victual-side cross-project tracking issue. Native implementation belongs in victual-kit, where the Apple clients live; no HealthKit reader belongs in this PHP repository. Link the corresponding victual-kit implementation issue/PR when created and keep release evidence here.

## Acceptance criteria

Revised 2026-10-12. The maintainer accepted simulator evidence on 2026-10-11: the victual-kit client in the iOS Simulator against a Victual stack on the Talos cluster with a disposable on-cluster database. A physical device is not required. Record: [plan 22, Executed, issue 702](https://github.com/datagen24/victual/blob/master/docs/plans/22-medication-tracking.md#issue-702-native-acceptance-on-simulator-evidence) and [`.devtools/plan22/NATIVE-ACCEPTANCE.md`](https://github.com/datagen24/victual/blob/master/.devtools/plan22/NATIVE-ACCEPTANCE.md).

- [ ] Supported platform versions and per-medication authorization recorded for the native client. Evidence: victual-kit `docs/acceptance/ui-round-1-phone.md` (iOS 27.0 simulator) and the authorization rows of `docs/acceptance/plan-22-native.md`, at victual-kit `055553e`.
- [ ] Medication-to-product/unit mapping and source-location selection exercised in the simulator against the cluster-hosted server, with administrator, Adult and Child keys. Evidence: `ui-round-1-phone.md` cases 7a to 7c; `macos-app-manual-test.md`.
- [ ] Synchronization, retry, reconciliation and refill behaviour covered by client unit tests plus a replay of this repository's 28 consumption-event fixtures against a v0.4.0 instance (tag commit `f73d2bec`, 28 of 28 passed; fixtures 16 and 17 ran with two administrators). Evidence: `plan-22-native.md`, `live-server-replay.md`.
- [ ] Simulator end-to-end scenario: authorize, map, import a taken event, retry without another deduction, correct or reconcile it, and read inventory and refill presentation. Do not publish real health details in evidence.
- [ ] Link exact client and server commits for every piece of evidence, and keep native evidence separate from server fixture coverage.

**Not verified, and not demonstrated by server fixtures:** the behaviour of a real Health store, late and background delivery, and identifier changes on edit and delete. These are known from Apple's documentation and the client's design only. The v0.5.0 release record lists them as limitations.

Housekeeping before closing: the victual-kit acceptance matrix names client commit `743ab1f`, which no longer resolves after a rebase and predates the v0.4.0 spec pin.

HealthKit research: https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/321/ . No Victual dose scheduler or dose-alert implementation is included. Track unresolved native work explicitly rather than marking it complete from API tests.

## Dependencies

Complete the applicable design decisions and predecessor work before the dependent implementation.
